caption:
A finished job ends in silence at most shops.

The next two hours decide if that customer reviews you or forgets you.

Four messages can run automatically once the work is done, from booking confirmation to review ask.

Example workflow, illustrative, not a client account.

1. Confirmation: booked window, reply to confirm
2. Dispatch: tech's on the way, real ETA
3. Wrap-up: job done, invoice link, thank you
4. Two hours later: a short, specific review request

Most owners nail step one by phone and stop there. Every skipped step after that is a customer who forgets who did the work.

See it running on your own number. 14 days free.

rationale: Carousels/slideshows still lead B2B saves and depth, and the day-of-service text sequence (confirmation through review ask) is a genuinely unclaimed demonstration distinct from every prior pipeline, reminder, no-show, and review-gating system already shipped.
